content.title: What a Federal Reserve rate cut means for your finances
content.summary: The Federal Reserve cut its benchmark interest rate by a quarter point Wednesday for the second time since September.  Before that, it had gone nine months without a cut.  The federal funds rate is the rate at which banks borrow and lend to one another.
